title: Learning from Online User Feedback for Shopping Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.11604v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model-based shopping agents are increasingly deployed in real-world e-commerce platforms, generating massive amounts of user interaction logs that provide valuable supervision for improving these agents. However, existing approaches primarily rely on offline training signals, such as user-item interactions or synthetic preference data, while largely overlooking the rich supervision contained in users' natural conversational feedback. Moreover, the available online feedback is heterogeneous, sparse, and noisy, making it difficult to transform into reliable learning signals automatically. translated_title: 从在线用户反馈中学习购物代理
translated_abstract: 基于大型语言模型的购物代理正越来越多地部署在真实世界的电商平台上，产生大量用户交互日志，这些日志为改进这些代理提供了宝贵的监督信号。然而，现有方法主要依赖于离线训练信号，如用户-物品交互或合成偏好数据，而很大程度上忽略了用户自然对话反馈中包含的丰富监督信息。此外，可用的在线反馈具有异质性、稀疏性和噪声性，这使得自动将其转化为可靠的学习信号变得困难。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了LOFA框架，该框架使购物代理能够直接从真实在线交互日志中学习，无需人工标注。LOFA结合了基于可验证购买结果的强化学习和反馈感知的在线策略蒸馏，该策略识别用户对话中的指令并将其转化。
tldr: 本文提出LOFA框架，利用真实在线用户交互日志中的对话反馈，结合强化学习和反馈感知蒸馏，实现无需人工标注的购物代理自动学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LOFA, a framework that leverages conversational feedback from real online interaction logs, combining reinforcement learning and feedback-aware distillation to enable automatic learning for shopping agents without human annotation.
